rate_card._note: Anthropic API list prices, USD per MILLION tokens. Claude Code subscription (Max/Pro) billing is a flat fee — these figures are the indicative API-equivalent cost of the measured token usage, NOT an invoice.
rate_card._schema: Each entry: {input, cache_write_5m, cache_write_1h, cache_read, output} in $/MTok. aggregate.py resolves a usage model id to a rate: models[<exact-id>] wins; else the first families[<key>] whose key is a substring of the model id; else default_family. value_summary.cost_allocation_note: `cost_allocated` splits each day's `_unattributed` measured cost across the tasks with a changelog entry that day (even split; days with >4 active tasks skipped as bulk-edit noise). Cost is measured; only the split is estimated. Bounded by session-transcript coverage.
value_summary.note: MODELED, UNCALIBRATED estimate — not a measured saving. Hours saved = by-hand person-hour estimate (ranged) − agentic supervised-attention hours (conservative: floor uses agentic-max). ~half of by-hand personas are judgment-tier; most task estimates are low-confidence retrospective backfill (see tasks_retrospective). Independent blind re-estimate of a 12-task sample showed ~88% mean inter-estimator deviation — treat as order-of-magnitude, lead with the conservative `min`.
